use_case_name: Check Files for Duplicates and Corruption

claims.content: The user checks selected files to identify duplicates and verify integrity against known checksums or hash values to detect corruption.

goal.raw_text: The user checks selected files to identify duplicates and verify integrity against known checksums or hash values to detect corruption.

claims.content: User
The user has selected one or more files to check.
The user has known checksum or hash values for the files to verify integrity.
The user initiates the file checking utility to find duplicates or verify file integrity.

trigger.raw_text: The user initiates the file checking utility to find duplicates or verify file integrity.

claims.content: The user selects one or more files in the file manager interface to check.
The user invokes the file checking utility (e.g., via the '?' shortcut or menu) to calculate checksums/hashes for the selected files.
The system compares the calculated checksums/hashes against known values provided by the user to detect corruption or identifies duplicate files based on matching hashes.
The system displays the results, indicating which files are duplicates or corrupted.
The system has identified which of the selected files are duplicates based on matching hash values.
The system has verified the integrity of the selected files by comparing calculated checksums against known values to detect corruption.
The results indicating duplicate or corrupted files are displayed to the user.
